mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.1% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.1%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a tightening monetary policy cycle that increases real interest rates and reduces corporate profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a high level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals an overheating economy that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above its 90th percentile, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in late-cycle regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) above 2100 thousand units signals strong residential demand, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2100, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong economic momentum, which increases corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO and GDPC1 both rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, high inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals that the Federal Reserve is aggressively raising rates to combat inflation, which increases the risk of a recession and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5% year-over-year, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in tightening cycles is below 0.03.
